exclusion_detail: The featured probes (7, 8; probe 8 with pipecolinic acid at P2 is the paper's new selective cell-permeable probe) are tetrapeptide acyloxymethylketone activity-based probes with an azido-hexanoyl N-terminus and a BODIPY/fluorophore tag, assembled by peptide chemistry and click conjugation (Scheme 1 'General Synthesis Route of the New ABPs'), i.e. peptide-based conjugates.

lead.label: probe 8
lead.why: Abstract: the non-natural amino acid pipecolinic acid at P2 'leads to improved selectivity toward MALT1 and results in cell-permeable fluorescent probes'; the text calls out 'new probe 8' as the selective probe used in follow-up cell experiments.

notes: Lead identified from the discussion text (probe 8 vs probes 7 and 9), not from the abstract itself, which names no compound number. Not transcribed since it is a peptidic conjugate. No SI file in the bundle.
